# LawStack
> LawStack builds single-function practice tools for solo and small law firms that use Clio.

LawStack Inc. is a Washington state corporation based in Tacoma, WA. We build a portfolio of single-function tools that connect to Clio Manage via OAuth, read one category of operational data, and deliver practice intelligence by plain-text email. No dashboards. No login after setup. Zero configuration after the initial Clio connection.

## What LawStack does
Each tool solves one confirmed attorney pain. It connects to Clio via read-only OAuth. It runs on a schedule or webhook. It sends one email. It stops when the problem is resolved.

## The tools
- **Deadline Reminder** (free) — Every Monday at 7am, every deadline across all open Clio matters, each linked to the matter. lawstack.co/apps/deadline-reminder
- **Unbilled Time Tracker** ($49/mo) — Every Sunday at 6pm, every uninvoiced time entry and its dollar value. lawstack.co/apps/unbilled-time-tracker
- **New Matter Checklist** ($29/mo) — Fires within 60 seconds of matter.created in Clio. Intake checklist delivered to attorney. lawstack.co/apps/new-matter-checklist
- **Invoice Reminder** ($59/mo) — When a Clio invoice goes unpaid past the attorney's threshold, sends a professional reminder to the client. Stops when paid. lawstack.co/apps/invoice-reminder
- **Trust Account Alert** ($49/mo) — Weekly scan of Clio trust balances. Alert fires before any balance drops below threshold. lawstack.co/apps/trust-account-alert
- **Matter Profitability** ($49/mo) — Monthly email: every matter type ranked by effective hourly rate, realization rate, and collected amount. lawstack.co/apps/matter-profitability
- **Conflict Check Log** ($39/mo) — Fires on every new matter. Logs conflict check prompt. Stores attorney confirmation as malpractice defense record. lawstack.co/apps/conflict-check-log
- **Retainer Chaser** ($49/mo) — When an active matter has no signed retainer, fires a 3-touch sequence. Stops when retainer is signed. lawstack.co/apps/retainer-chaser
- **Taita** — Practice intelligence. One email every Sunday from your actual practice data. iq.lawstack.co

## Clio integration
All tools connect via Clio's standard OAuth 2.0 API. Read-only access only. LawStack cannot create, modify, or delete anything in your Clio account. Available in the Clio App Directory. Requires a paid Clio Manage plan (Essentials or higher).

## Compliance
WSBA RPC 1.6 compliant. LawStack accesses operational metadata only — matter names, dates, billing totals, trust balances. No client confidential information is accessed, stored, or processed. No model training on attorney data.
